description: This source file defines the IdempotencyKeyMiddleware class, a middleware component for ASP.NET Core that implements idempotency semantics for HTTP methods. It intercepts unsafe requests with a specific header, stores or replays responses to ensure duplicate requests with the same idempotency key do not duplicate side effects.

classes.name: IdempotencyKeyMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class providing idempotency for unsafe HTTP methods using the X-Idempotency-Key request header. Handles storing, retrieving, and replaying responses for duplicate requests.

methods.name: IsUnsafeMethod
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP method is one of POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE, which are considered unsafe for idempotency handling.

methods.name: IsAssetOperationPath
methods.description: Determines if the request path corresponds to asset operation endpoints to apply idempotency logic.

methods.name: BuildCompositeKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key based on the request's method, path, query string, and the idempotency key header value for uniquely identifying requests.

methods.name: CaptureHeaders
methods.description: Captures headers from the response, excluding hop-by-hop headers and content length, to store the response state.

methods.name: ApplyHeaders
methods.description: Restores stored headers to the HTTP response.

methods.name: WriteStoredResponseAsync
methods.description: Writes a stored response (status code, headers, body) to the HttpResponse, marking whether it is a replay.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main middleware method that handles incoming requests, checks for idempotency header, manages stored responses, and controls downstream execution accordingly.
